warning.titlePre: Mercedes R63 AMG Camshaft Adjuster & Head Bolt Wear
paragraphs: If your R63 AMG has the M156 V8 - that's the 6.2-litre AMG engine fitted to the extremely limited 2006-2007 production run - camshaft adjuster and head bolt wear is a well-established pattern on this engine, confirmed by AMG specialist sources. We replace the camshaft adjuster, timing chain, and bearings as standard on every M156 rebuild.
